scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p client && tsc --noEmit -p server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run build && STATIC_DIR=client/dist node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning server/src/main.ts
scripts.docker:server: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -f server/Dockerfile -t santinh-rt:test --load .
